statement: This request authorizes GoreeCloud Search Release Candidate #09 publication and isolated image-level candidate/rollback rehearsal from the exact reviewed source boundary that includes the merged UI rebuild plus Search-specific Privacy Shield and Wardveil Security integrations. It does not authorize production cutover, target-host changes, Stable promotion, compatibility-name retirement, or rollback-material deletion. Final target-runtime, real-provider, monitoring and alert-delivery, application-level recovery, physical Android, desktop/persisted-theme, actual compiled GoreeCloud Browser, Privacy Shield production-boundary, and Wardveil production-runtime acceptance remain separate required evidence.
